name: CellNet pretraining data
source: 100000-cell pretraining sample; public sample IDs anonymized
data_kind: Rendered expression images and dataset-specific measured-gene masks, not raw count matrices
assets: Fitted layouts and gene vocabulary are provided in assets/
upstream_terms: Original datasets retain their respective terms and attribution. Apache-2.0 applies to software, not automatically to third-party data. Dataset identifiers are provided per cell; licenses have not been individually verified.
biological_limits: Small deterministic demonstration of file format and loading; no representativeness, biological validation, donor independence or performance claim.
